inhomogeneous_deformation.description: [b_j^s, a_1^sigma] = -gb_{sigma,j,s} kappa ; [X,Y}_gamma = [X,Y}_0 + kappa * gamma(X,Y) (kappa on the left)

gb_matrix.parameter_parity_note: scalars; the odd parity of the deformation is carried by kappa

inhomogeneous_deformation.gamma_parity_rule: p(gamma(X,Y)) = p(X) + p(Y) + 1 (mod 2); constant (K) terms dropped
